about_the_game:
Race across the endless dunes in SANDSPEED: CAMEL RACING, an action camel racing game where speed and skill determine the champion! Compete in high-speed races and challenging time trials, push your camel to the limit as you dash through desertic landscapes.

Why play SANDSPEED:

  • It's not about horsepower, It's about camelpower: Compete against swift rivals or test your reflexes in time-based challenges.

  • Sweet "Super" Sweet Watermelons: Snag juicy speed boosts by collecting watermelons on the track.

  • Master the Desert: Dodge hazards and conquer shifting terrain to stay ahead.

  • Feel the Thrill: Experience immersive desert-themed music and realistic racing sound effects.

  • Unlock & Explore: Earn achievements, unlock new tracks, and uncover hidden surprises as you climb the tournament.

Are you ready to dominate the dunes and become the ultimate camel racing champion? The race is on!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Quad core CPU 3.3 GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 560 (4GB VRAM) / NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti (4GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Quad core CPU 4.6 GHz
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 5700 / NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1070
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

short_description: Forget SUPERCARS, this is how real legends race! Dash through endless dunes, Outrun your rivals, and gobble up power-ups to stay in the lead. It's wild, it's fast, Do you have what it takes to become the ultimate Egyptian champion?
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean, Spanish - Latin America, Japanese, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Turkish
